releaseNotes: PRVN Music v0.12 (Build 15): Fixed Googlevideo PO token rejection (E60065) with fresh BotGuard session invalidation & capped automatic stream recovery; fixed Play Together listener no-audio & granular stream states; fixed false -63,406ms clock skew & separated Network RTT from sync drift; fixed Home bottom navigation to open PRVN Discover; fixed in-app update prompts during auto-download, uncached update checks, and added Android notifications for app updates and Play Together song requests.
